title: And Ever Since Then… (Resolution)
use_cases: Use when establishing the aftermath of a narrative climax
Implement when showing character transformation and world changes
Use when providing closure to the audience in a storytelling framework
Configure when bridging the gap between a finished conflict and a stable setting
content:
The closing section shows the new normal after the climactic events. This resolution reveals how characters and their world have changed because of the story’s events.

For instance, at the end of Finding Nemo, Marlin learns to be less overprotective, allowing Nemo more freedom while maintaining their close bond.
